author: Ari Koslow
title: Yuki Kawamura to play for Pacers Summer League team
desc: Yuki Kawamura will play NBA Summer League with the Indiana Pacers.
impact: The Bulls did not tender a qualifying offer to Kawamura.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dru Smith to have salary fully guaranteed by Heat
desc: The Miami Heat will fully guarantee the $2.6 million salary for guard Dru Smith.
impact: Smith will remain in a depth role off the bench for Miami.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Goga Bitadze drawing trade interest from Clippers
desc: The Clippers are showing trade interest in Goga Bitadze.
impact: The Clippers are expected to try to re-sign John Collins. If they're unable to do so, Bitadze is expected to be a trade target for them.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Robert Williams III linked to Celtics
desc: The Celtics are expected to show interest in Robert Williams III.
impact: Williams appeared in 59 games last season with Portland. He would figure to step into a reserve role wherever he lands.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kevon Looney linked to Celtics, Knicks
desc: The Celtics and Knicks are expected to show interest in Kevon Looney.
impact: Looney had his team option declined by the Pelicans, making him an unrestricted free agent. The Knicks are likely to lose Mitchell Robinson in free agency, making them a potential destination for a reserve center.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marcus Smart expected to draw interest from Rockets
desc: The Rockets are reportedly the most likely team to land Marcus Smart.
impact: Houston is most likely to give Smart a multi-year deal. The players and teams can begin to discuss deals on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ziaire Williams expected to draw interest from Lakers
desc: The Lakers are expected to show interest in Ziaire Williams.
impact: Williams had his team option declined by the Nets, making him an unrestricted free agent. He would figure to step into a reserve role with the Lakers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John Collins to draw interest from Magic, Spurs, Sixers
desc: John Collins is expected to draw interest from the Magic, Spurs and Sixers.
impact: Collins made 56 starts across 69 total appearances last season with the Clippers. He averaged 13.6 points on 55 percent shooting from the field. He could hold some fantasy value in the right landing spot for fantasy managers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Buddy Hield to have salary fully guaranteed by Hawks
desc: The Atlanta Hawks will fully guarantee the $9.66 million salary for Buddy Hield.
impact: Hield was traded to Atlanta in the middle of last season. He remains a player to monitor on the trade market this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Manon tendered by Lakers
desc: The Lakers have tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Chris Manon.
impact: Manon will now be a restricted free agent this summer. He will figure to remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Clarkson could re-sign with Knicks
desc: Jordan Clarkson remains a possibility to re-sign with Knicks.
impact: The big issue for New York in free agency is wanting to avoid the second apron. It remains unclear as of now who they will re-sign and let go.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kristaps Porzingis expected to reach new deal with Warriors soon
desc: Kristaps Porzingis is expected to be back on a new deal with the Warriors before the free agency period starts.
impact: Porzingis and Golden State are reportedly close to an agreement on a new deal. The two sides should come to an agreement this upcoming week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Collin Sexton linked to Warriors
desc: The Warriors are expected to show interest in free agent Collin Sexton.
impact: Sexton appeared in 68 games with 22 starts between the Hornets and Bulls last season. He would add depth in the Warriors back court.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anfernee Simons linked to Warriors
desc: The Warriors are expected to show interest in free agent Anfernee Simons.
impact: Simons played in just six games after being traded to the Bulls in the middle of last season. He could play a prominent role alongside Stephen Curry if he reaches a deal with Golden State.
